subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to return to the secret base

60140101.text: Ugh, they've been prowling around for nearly two days now. These things just won't quit...

60140102.text: They might not have seen us yet, but with them constantly sweeping the area, our way out is completely blocked!

60140105.text: That's never gonna work... One little slip-up, and it's game over!

60140106.text: If they spot us, they'll run straight back to Rerir — and once he knows we're here, it won't be long before he's breathing down our necks again...

60140107.text: Be that as it may, we still have to try.

60140108.text: Ugh, guess you're right. Alright, time to zip it...

60140301.text: There's no end to these things!

60140307.text: Wait, what's that smell? ...Oh no, there's a fire!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Marionette and finish repairing the machine
Follow Marionette and finish repairing the machine

60141401.text: Hang in there, Pulonia. I'll have your core replaced in no time...

60141402.text: Ugh! Stupid Rächer of stupid Solnari... Ugh, whatever! I've got all the data I need. Next time we meet, you're finished!

60141404.text: Ugh... He sure doesn't pull his punches...

60141405.text: Excuse me, um... Do you need a hand?

60141406.text: You can do me a favor by staying OUT of my way. Can't you see I'm busy?

60141407.text: Wait a minute, I recognize that voice...

60141408.text: Hello, Miss Sandrone. "Father" sent us over to help.

60141410.text: Hey, uh... Freminet? Get over here and help me fix this. Lyney, you do your thing — just keep your sister away from my machines.

60141411.text: Nearly every machine that cat-girl touches ends up going haywire... Go put her on cleaning duty, or something.

60141413.text: Hehe... Then let's start downstairs. Freminet, we'll leave this place to you.

60141416.text: ...Pretty sure there's still some tea in the cupboard. If you want some, you'll have to make it yourselves.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the secret base and discuss your next steps

60140401.text: It's a relief to see you all made it back in one piece.

60140402.text: Huh? Feels like there's quite a few people missing... Where's Flins and the others? And what about Nefer?

60140403.text: I returned ahead of them. Flins is helping Aino and Ineffa to set up the decoys and buy us some time. As for Miss Nefer...

60140404.text: Boss is still wrapping things up on her end. She sent us back to fill you all in on the top-secret intel we've been gathering.

60140405.text: I see. Then let's get right into it.

60140406.text: But first — who do we have here? You brought someone else in to help?

60140407.text: Greetings. I was invited here to help as a long-time tea party companion of Columbina's. You may call me Arlecchino.

60140409.text: (Those eyes... Where have I seen them before? Wait, of course! In those memories we just saw...!)

60140410.text: Hmm. The only Arlecchino I know is the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. So either you share a pretty uncommon name, or you're more than just a tea-party buddy.

60140411.text: You're well informed, Grand Master. A man from Mondstadt living all the way out here in Nod-Krai, and yet the people and affairs of Snezhnaya seem to hold a special place in your heart.

60140412.text: Haha, the feeling's mutual. Sounds like you know all about who I am, too.

60140414.text: (The atmosphere in here just got really tense... Guess we can't just start trusting Fatui Harbingers, even at a time like this.)

60140415.text: I must admit, though, I'm a little curious — seeing as the Moon Goddess no longer belongs to the Fatui, what makes you so willing to put your neck on the line here?

60140416.text: Nor does Nod-Krai belong to Mondstadt, Mr. Varka. Yet still, you're fighting for it all the same.

60140417.text: Things don't always have to have a tangible payoff. Sometimes, stopping things from spiraling out of control is a higher priority than chasing the spoils of victory.

60140418.text: Of course, I can't say there's nothing in it for me at all... but that's between Columbina and myself.

60140421.text: Forgive me, I don't mean to doubt you. It's just that the Fatui really have been the source of many of our troubles.

60140422.text: We have our own way of doing things here in Nod-Krai. But ever since they arrived, the Fatui have treated us with nothing but hostility.

60140423.text: I know there's been a lot of bad blood between us in the past. I've done my utmost to avoid friction whenever I could, but sometimes, fundamental conflicts of interest simply can't be settled amicably.

60140424.text: That's why I'm here solely in a personal capacity. This has nothing to do with the Fatui.

60140425.text: As a gesture of good faith, I'll be frank. I can help Columbina track down the Iridescent Moon's marrow, which will help her restore more of her power.

60140426.text: Anyway, what else is on the agenda? Let's begin.

60140427.text: (She says she'll be frank, then completely skips over the details... Looks like she doesn't wanna give away too many secrets, after all.)

60140428.text: (But she clearly wants to change the subject. It'd be awkward if I tried to bring it up again now... Ugh, guess we'll just have to go along with it. She's the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers, after all... One look and you can tell she's not someone you'd wanna mess with.)

60140430.text: Well, since Ms. Arlecchino sounds confident in her ability to handle that, we'll proceed to the next topic. Jahoda, time to share that top-secret intel.

60140431.text: Ahem... Alright, listen up everyone! First, we now know that Rerir was originally a Khaenri'ahn secret agent whose primary mission was to hunt down and assassinate the so-called "Dregs of the Crimson Moon."

60140433.text: Mm-hmm. In the memories, there was a lot of talk about the "Crimson Moon" and "Eclipse," and a whole bunch of other stuff from the time of Khaenri'ah.

60140435.text: To my knowledge, those were the names of two different Khaenri'ahn dynasties.

60140436.text: Long, long ago, it is said that the people of Khaenri'ah worshiped the Crimson Moon, drawing a mysterious power from its reflection.

60140437.text: But one day, a coup saw the Crimson Moon "eclipsed" — hence the name of the new dynasty that replaced it, and how it became the new emblem of Khaenri'ah.

60140438.text: Still, long after the Crimson Moon dynasty had fallen, the last ruler of the Eclipse dynasty, the "Vinster King," still coveted the secrets it left behind. So he sent the "Rächer of Solnari" to secretly hunt down the Crimson Moon's few remaining followers.

60140439.text: In those days, Rerir showed no signs of madness — in fact, he was as normal as any other person. Oh... and he had a fiancee, or at least a would-be fiancee, called "Tholindis."

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the place The Knave mentioned
Go to the place The Knave mentioned

60140501.text: Here. This will serve as a good spot to cross over.

60140502.text: Arlecchino, hold up a second... Since you brought us all this way, would you mind telling us what you've got planned?

60140503.text: We still haven't got the slightest idea what's going on here! And if even Columbina doesn't know where the Iridescent Moon's marrow is, how do you?

60140504.text: Simple... Because I am an inheritor of the royal bloodline of the Crimson Moon, and one of the last surviving embers of the Two Worlds' Flames.

60140506.text: A—Are you serious? As in... you're a descendent of that Crimson Moon dynasty we were just talking about? The one from ancient Khaenri'ah?

60140507.text: Your surprise is understandable. I was also taken aback when I first learned of it.

60140508.text: But the more I thought about it, the more I realized — the signs had been there all along.

60140509.text: When I was young, I discovered I could wield a very special kind of "fire." It coursed like blood through my veins, and smoldered away inside my nerves.

60140510.text: What's more, whenever I experienced strong bursts of emotion or drew too deeply on this power, it was like some kind of presence within the fire would begin to gnaw away at me... consuming me from the inside out.

60140512.text: Exactly... That is why my hands are like this too. At first, I saw it only as a curse. But once I became a Harbinger, The Jester apprised me of the truth.

60140513.text: Together with my own investigations over the past few years, there are several things that I have gradually come to understand.

60140514.text: For instance, take the so-called "Crimson Moon." In truth, it is nothing more than the shattered remnants of the Iridescent Moon, fused with the Abyss to prolong its lifespan.

60140515.text: Since this "bloodflame" was bestowed upon me by the Crimson Moon, it is a fusion of the Iridescent Moon's former power and the corruption of the Abyss.

60140516.text: You all understand the nature of the Abyss well enough. I draw upon its power, and in return, it hungers for my soul. This strange blackness is the mark of corruption it has left behind.

60140517.text: If I recall correctly, you once told me that if the corruption ever made it to your heart, you'd become a completely different person.

60140518.text: Yes... and that's the reason I'm always careful not to push my power too far. It's essentially a never-ending tug-of-war.

60140520.text: ...Anyway, the rest of my story can wait. Is there anything else about the Crimson Moon or the Iridescent Moon that you're unclear about?

60140521.text: Paimon has a question... So the Crimson Moon that the Khaenri'ahns used to worship was actually the Iridescent Moon, right? Which was one of the Three Moon Sisters?

60140522.text: Does that mean that... the Khaenri'ahns were to the Crimson Moon as the Frostmoon Scions are to the Frost Moon...?

60140523.text: So much of that history has been lost. We have no way of knowing exactly what they were like.

60140524.text: But I would suspect that the Khaenri'ahns weren't as devout in their moon worship as it might appear. The Iridescent Moon's remains simply served as their link to the Abyss.

60140525.text: Later on, perhaps someone discovered a way to make direct contact with the Abyss, or maybe there was some kind of ideological divide. Either way, a dissenting faction staged a coup and drove out the royal heirs of the Crimson Moon dynasty.

60140526.text: Still, even with the dark sun looming high overhead, the Crimson Moon's glow never truly faded. If you want living proof, it's standing right before you.

60140527.text: The first time we met, I sensed something familiar in your presence.

60140528.text: When I looked at you, I felt I could see that mysterious red moon in the corner of my eye... In your flames, I saw its broken image, surrounded by a strange black aura.

60140529.text: Well, I appreciate that you kept it to yourself. Much about the Crimson Moon is still a mystery, and I'd prefer not to end up as the object of an insane research project.

60140530.text: Anyway, time is against us here, so if there's any other questions, they'll have to wait.

60140531.text: I just want to make sure I've got one thing straight. In her letter, Sandrone mentioned that since you are unable to contain the Iridescent Moon's marrow yourself, you intend to leave it in my custody. Correct?

60140532.text: That's right. For now, it's the only way I can pay you back for your help.

60140533.text: The Iridescent Moon is already part of who you are. So with its marrow in your possession, you'll be even more powerful than before.

60140535.text: Uhh... get what started? What does this place have to do with the Crimson Moon?

60140536.text: When I first became a Harbinger, The Jester gave me a book called Perinheri, also known as Hleobranto Innamorato.

60140537.text: You should be able to buy a copy next time you're in Fontaine. It's a love story set in the Crimson Moon era — but setting aside the tangled romances of its characters, it also records a few interesting details.

60140538.text: In the Crimson Moon era — or so the story goes — there was an orphanage that received children from beyond the bounds of this world and subjected them to a peculiar induction ceremony.

60140539.text: Beyond the bounds of this world? For real? And what kind of induction ceremony?

60140540.text: The Crimson Moon sages looked beyond this world for beings with powers that surpassed the gods — but fearing they might lose control, they subjected these children to a process of "refinement."

60140541.text: They made these children crawl up a fireplace, and kept asking them, "Have you died?" "Did you see it?"... until they finally admitted to having died and seen a crimson moon.

60140542.text: The adults embraced the children who passed the ritual, telling them: "Within the fireplace, you have traversed the flames between two worlds. Here and now, you are born anew."

60140543.text: The book leaves much unsaid, but I suspect that this was their way of "branding" the children they had enrolled — leaving an indelible mark upon them, so that they would forever live in the Crimson Moon's light.

60140544.text: That explains why I can't sense the Crimson Moon's marrow in this world. It makes sense that it would be sealed in a special space that can only be accessed temporarily through some kind of ritual.

60140545.text: But there's no fireplace here... Do you see a chimney anywhere? ...Oh, are we supposed to build it ourselves? Umm... okay fine, Paimon'll go find some bricks...

60140546.text: That won't be necessary — the fireplace is purely symbolic. The key to the ritual is crossing "the flames between two worlds"... in other words, the flames that burn within me.

60140547.text: Those burned away by such flames leave behind a kind of ghostly "afterimage" in the world. In the days of Khaenri'ah, people believed they could be used to bridge the gap between the "two worlds" of life and death.

60140548.text: In short, I can open a passage to that space for you. That's the easy part.

60140549.text: The catch is, I'll need to stay on this side to keep the passage open, so I won't be able to come with you. Once you're inside, you'll have to find your own way.

60140552.text: Very well, then I'll open it up.

60140553.text: #{NICKNAME}, spare me a little more moonlight, if you would. I may need it...

60140554.text: Thank you... I feel like I've recovered some of my strength now. It should be enough to move us across short distances and confront whatever dangers might await.

60140555.text: Mistress of the Seven Hues of ages past, great mother of the present, crimson-clad sovereign of the two realms. By fire severed, by fire renewed — I offer myself now, and beseech your descent.

60140557.text: One word of advice — as you're crossing over, no matter what voices you hear, do not answer.

60140559.text: I sense a sinister gloom inside... but also the familiar light of the moon.

60140560.text: I feel that I am about to meet an old friend who has changed beyond all recognition... Alright, let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the space where the Crimson Moon is

60140601.text: Hey, look up at the sky! A red moon... This must be the spot, right?

60140602.text: I—Is that the Abyss!? It's practically filled the entire place! What now?

60140604.text: *sigh* What a tragic sight... Fragments of your broken body, seized by the Abyss and hung up aloft like mummified remains. Iridescent Moon... was this truly what you wished for?

60140607.text: Careful, there's something spooky about this place. Feels like something is lurking in the fog...

60140608.text: #P—Paimon's right behind you, {NICKNAME}. Whatever you do, don't run off without her!

60141503.text: So the Iridescent Moon's marrow is up there in the sky?

60141504.text: Huh, for real? But that's way too high... There's no way we'll be able to reach it!

60141505.text: No... I'm not sensing anything up there.

60141506.text: It's coming from under the mountain.

60141507.text: Let's see... Eek! There's some kind of weird shadow over the water!

60141508.text: Wait, see that? Looks like a mechanism of some sort... Let's check it out!

60141601.text: Hey, look at that! Now that the mechanism's running, the shadow in the water looks different.

60141602.text: Do you think these mechanisms might be the key to unlocking the secret? Let's try to find more of them.

60141603.text: Tholindis, we'll leave the rest of the research in your hands. We'll be heading back now.

60141604.text: Hope this isn't ruining date night...?

60141605.text: Ugh, mind your own business. Just leave me some snacks on the table.

60141606.text: Tholindis? Is that Rerir's girlfriend? How come we're hearing her voice here?

60141609.text: Oh, yeah! So... do you think she was studying this strange space all along?

60141610.text: The Abyss has made this space extremely unstable.

60141611.text: Maybe that's why some of the things she said and did were preserved here... like echoes, or afterimages.

60141612.text: ...Whenever I see this view, it takes me back to a poem from my childhood.

60141613.text: "Waning moon, oh lifeless damsel, weeping on the mountain crest. Mourning still, in wistful tone, her fragile soul now laid to rest."

60141614.text: For me, of all people, to be here investigating the mysteries of the Crimson Moon's space... Is it a coincidence, or something more?

60141701.text: I see... So the Moon Marrow, or rather the power of the three moons, is the key to unlocking ■■■■.

60141702.text: If ■■■■ really does exist, then maybe this madness can finally be put to an end...

60141801.text: With the Abyss inhibitors in place, I should be able to access the chamber with the Moon Marrow...

60141802.text: Oh, Rerir... With every step you take, you're drifting further from what you truly desire... but you're not the root of the problem. Ever since that outsider set foot in Khaenri'ah, the Vinster King has sunken deeper into madness.

60141803.text: If only I could get my hands on that outsider...

60141804.text: Hey, look! The moon's reflection is back to normal!

60141805.text: Tholindis's voice mentioned a chamber with the Moon Marrow. D'you think maybe it's hidden in the moon's reflection...?

60141806.text: It must be... for within it, I sense the fragile aura of a dying soul.

60141807.text: Then there's no time to lose — let's go!

60140902.text: The Iridescent Moon's marrow... Still burning away like an undying flame, yet now contaminated by the Abyss. It has taken on a new form entirely.

60140903.text: If we can purify the Abyssal power within, we should be able to obtain its untainted essence.

60140906.text: Is it you? Are you here?

60140907.text: Huh? Are you talking to us?

60140908.text: At long last... I can see you once more. Our fates have crossed... and I am finally free.

60140909.text: I'm sorry... I lied to you. Even knowing what was to come, I still couldn't let go of the fear in my heart as death drew near.

60140910.text: The moment the moon shattered, my body began to split apart piece by piece... like I was being cut into pieces by a thousand blunt blades. My thoughts scattered as the cold crept in... but I could not bear to fade away like that...

60140911.text: Tell me, what was it that brought you to us, all that time ago? If only I had possessed your courage... Then, I might have been spared this torment more painful than death...

60140912.text: You look so puzzled... Heh, that's how I felt too... when I first saw you...

60140913.text: But trust me when I say... that everything happens for a reason. Farewell, Hypo...

60140915.text: What was that all about? Was that the Goddess of the Iridescent Moon...?

60140916.text: It sounded like she was speaking to a long-lost friend... but none of us have ever met her before, right?

60140917.text: Perhaps... she took me for the Goddess of the Frost Moon she once knew.

60140918.text: For a fading soul like hers, our auras must be too similar to tell apart.

60140919.text: Hmm... It felt like there was a deeper meaning to what she was saying...

60140920.text: But anyway, we've got the Iridescent Moon's marrow now. That should help you regain your strength, right?

60140921.text: Alright, time to leave this place and meet back up with Arlecchino. Let's go!

60141202.text: Was that you, Arlecchino? Did you save us?

60141204.text: Oh, this? Don't worry... It's a small price to pay.

60141205.text: The Abyss wanted to trap you inside, and I defied its will by bringing you out. No wonder it's a little angry.

60141208.text: No — I have paid the price, albeit a small one, and it cannot be undone. My hands have already fused with the Abyss. Purification would simply destroy whatever's left of them.

60141210.text: *sigh* We're so sorry, Arlecchino. Paimon can't believe you'd make a sacrifice like this for us...

60141211.text: As much as I'd like to call it a favor, the truth is, I was simply holding up my end of the deal. Well, Columbina?

60141212.text: Yes, you did your part. And as promised, I will leave the Iridescent Moon's marrow in your care. From this day forth, may the Two Worlds' Flames burn ever more brightly.

60141213.text: I'll take that as a blessing. Now, Columbina, give me your hand. Accept this moonlight I offer in return.

60141218.text: I'm fine.... Our powers are... a little at odds, that's all.

60141219.text: By the Frost Moon's authority alone, wielding the power of the other moons was always going to be a stretch. Still, I think it's fair to say that your strength has returned... at least to the level it was at as third harbinger.

60141220.text: It's still not enough. There's no way I can hope to challenge Rerir like this.

60141221.text: Just... one more ray of moonlight, if you would.

60143001.text: Seismic changes often begin with small windows of opportunity. This could be your window.

60143101.text: What happened over at Amsvartnir... If it wasn't Rerir, then who was it?

60149911.text: Whew... It was a close call, but we got the Iridescent Moon's marrow and restored Columbina's strength, and that's all that matters.

60149912.text: In other words, mission accomplished! Paimon wonders how everyone else is doing...
